# Donut (`donut`)

<!-- Generated by scripts/docs.js from schema.json. Edit the schema, then run `npm run docs`. -->

Shows how a whole splits into up to six parts, with the total in the middle and each part's share beside it.

**Use when:** Part-to-whole for one total split into 2 to 6 parts: revenue mix by category, open order lines by item class, Commercial vs SLED split.

**Don't use when:** The parts don't add up to a meaningful whole, or you are comparing values across categories (use bar_chart), there are more than 6 parts (group the smallest into "Other", or use bar_chart), or the split changes over time (use line_chart or a stacked bar_chart).

**Sizes:** S, M (default), L

## Fields

Fields from `id` to `note` are shared by every widget.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"donut"` | yes | Always "donut". |
| `id` | string | yes | Unique id within the dashboard: lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens, e.g. "open-ar". |
| `title` | string | yes | What the widget shows, in sentence case with no trailing period, e.g. "Revenue by rep, Q3 2026". |
| `subtitle` | string |  | Optional one line of context under the title: scope, filter, or unit. |
| `size` | `"S"` \| `"M"` \| `"L"` |  | Width on the 12-column grid (S = 3, M = 6, L = 9, full = 12). Allowed: S, M, L. Default: `"M"`. |
| `note` | string |  | Optional footnote: caveats, definitions, or why data is missing. |
| `slices` | list of object | yes | The parts of the whole, largest first. Group anything past the fifth part into a final "Other" slice. |
| `slices[].label` | string | yes | Name of the part, e.g. "Networking". |
| `slices[].value` | number | yes | The part's raw amount (count or dollars), not its share. The donut computes shares from the total. |
| `format` | `"number"` \| `"integer"` \| `"currency"` |  | How the total and slice values are displayed. Shares are always shown as percents. Default: `"number"`. |
| `center_label` | string |  | Short label under the total in the middle of the donut, e.g. "Open lines". Default: "Total". |

## Example

```json
{
  "type": "donut",
  "id": "open-lines-by-class",
  "title": "Open order lines by item class",
  "subtitle": "All branches, as of today",
  "size": "M",
  "format": "integer",
  "center_label": "Open lines",
  "slices": [
    { "label": "Client devices", "value": 1284 },
    { "label": "Networking", "value": 612 },
    { "label": "Audio visual", "value": 377 },
    { "label": "Software licenses", "value": 241 },
    { "label": "Other", "value": 96 }
  ]
}
```

## Checks beyond the schema

- Error when two slices share a label.
- Error when every slice is 0.
- Warns when the values add up to 1 (they look like shares; pass the raw amounts).
- Warns when slices aren't sorted largest first (a slice named "Other" may come last).
